answer: Delayed settlement with shared loss pool.** Each new identity must wait until the next dawn to transact, while its first trades draw from a shared pool funded by all members. If a clone misbehaves before the pulse check, the pool absorbs the loss and the clone's future access is frozen. Honest agents pay only a small quartz-denominated membership levy per period. An attacker cloning N identities pays N levies plus the full pool liability per failed clone, making mass cloning costlier than one honest participant.
